summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project, serving the project's contract administrator, commercial/QS team, and QA engineers. It uses the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record to administer progress claims (measured against BOQ quantities, with retention per Clause 14.3), track delay damages against the Clause 8.7 rate and cap, hold QA/ITP records, and maintain a document register that ties every instrument back to its source clause or BOQ line.
